text:
Elaine (Mktg): Quick sync — we need the final benchmark narrative + slide deck for the launch + webinar. Primary ask: make the latency vs cost story crystal for two audiences: platform teams (SRE/Infra) and product/PM. Ideas for chart axes and a simple 3-panel flow?
Noah (Growth): For PMs, start with 'tokens to $', simple line chart. For infra folks, a heatmap of latency distribution by model/seq-length.
Leah (Design): Agree on two views. Also add a single 'decision matrix' slide: cost vs latency vs reliability with recommended levers. I can mock visuals tomorrow. :sparkles:
Ben P (Product): Love the decision matrix. Also propose a slide that shows real config tradeoffs: batching vs quantization vs fallback model. Each with estimated % cost change and latency delta.
Sam (Eng): We can get realistic numbers from the sim runs — I'll export median/p95/p99 and cost per 1M tokens for the top 5 model variants. Want CSV or a sample JSON?
Elaine (Mktg): CSV is easiest for draft slides. Noah — we need 3 headline hooks for the webinar registration copy that map to the visuals.
Noah (Growth): Hooks: 1) "Cut your LLM token bill without trading quality" 2) "Predictable latency at scale: how we route and degrade" 3) "Real-world tradeoffs: quantize, batch, or tier" Short, punchy.
Leah (Design): For the heatmap, axis suggestion: x=model variant (gpt-style, open-llama, etc.), y=sequence length bucket (0-128,129-512,513-2048). Color=median latency. Add dots for cost-per-token overlay.
Ben P (Product): Also show a stacked waterfall for per-request cost (compute + memory + infra overhead). That helps finance folks.
Sam (Eng): I'll produce two tables: latency matrix (median/p95/p99) and cost breakdown (GPU sec per 1k tokens, amortized infra). ETA EOD.
Elaine (Mktg): Great. Also we need an inbound routing playbook slide — mapping leads to funnel stages based on their signals. Propose tags: "latency-first", "cost-conscious", "enterprise-SLA".
Noah (Growth): Add lead scoring rules: if they viewed 'Dedicated' slide AND downloaded the benchmark CSV => score +30. If they attended webinar and asked infra questions => +50.
Leah (Design): Visual idea: a funnel with the three persona lanes (PM, Platform, Finance) and callouts for the specific chart that resonates with each lane.
Sam (Eng): Quick note: for any claims about % improvements we must include methodology footnote: dataset, prompt shape, sequence distribution, and hardware (A100 v4 / H100). I'll add a one-line footnote we can shrink.
Elaine (Mktg): Yes include methodology. Also need two CTA variations on slides/landing: 1) "Run a guided benchmark with us" 2) "Get a cost-optimized config for your workload" — we'll A/B test.
Noah (Growth): For webinar format: 20 min narrative + 10 min demo (live dashboard showing 3-run comparison) + AMA. We should capture a short demo script with exact filters to show.
Leah (Design): I'll put placeholder screens for the dashboard: heatmap, waterfall, and decision matrix. Need CSV from Sam to lay actual numbers into charts.
Sam (Eng): Uploading CSV to the shared drive now: https://drive.redwood.ai/benchmarks/2770011234.csv — includes median/p95/p99, cost_per_1M_tokens, GPU_secs.
Ben P (Product): Perfect. I'll draft the slide text for the decision matrix and the tradeoff bullets. Elaine, want the slide deck by tomorrow morning?
Elaine (Mktg): Yes, preview by 10am PT. We'll iterate live on the call. Noah — can you draft two short email sequences for post-webinar follow-up mapped to the lead tags?
Noah (Growth): On it. Sequence A (latency-first): demo recap + invite to dev sandbox. Sequence B (cost-conscious): cost snapshot + offer a guided benchmark.
webinar-bot: New webinar created: "Benchmarking Latency & Unit Economics" — registration: https://events.redwood.ai/benchmark-launch — Tue Apr 15 10:00 PT
Leah (Design): Small ask — can we avoid complex legends? Use inline annotations on charts (e.g., callout: "+27% cost saved with KV cache"). Less legend-reading.
Sam (Eng): Good callouts. Also add a small table with deployment modes (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) mapped to expected latency band and cost tier.
Elaine (Mktg): Final checklist: slides (Leah/Ben) + CSV numbers (Sam) + hooks/email (Noah) + methodology footnote + landing page + registration (webinar-bot). I'll ping for a final 9:30am sync. :white_check_mark:
Noah (Growth): I'll draft the landing copy and two variants for the CTA.
Ben P (Product): I'll prepare the demo filters and the 3-run comparison script: (1) baseline, (2) quantized + batching, (3) tiered fallback.
Leah (Design): Mockup in Figma incoming, will post link here when ready.
Sam (Eng): CSV uploaded and I've also added a quick script to regenerate numbers if folks want to tweak seq-length buckets: `./bench/regen.sh --buckets 128,512,2048`
Elaine (Mktg): Awesome team. We'll iterate tomorrow. Anything else?
Noah (Growth): Maybe a topline testimonial callout from a pilot customer — I'll check with CS.
Leah (Design): thumbs up :thumbsup:
Ben P (Product): :rocket:
Elaine (Mktg): Thanks all — see you at 9:30am review."
